exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Sentence A; furthermore, Sentence B".

options.romaji: Mon A. Sono ue Mon B.

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 文A。そのうえ 文B。 matches "Sentence A; furthermore, Sentence B".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 文A。そのうえ 文B。.
exercises.explanation: Adds more information to Sentence A; Sentence B builds on it.
